title: PoliteChat
description: A lightweight Minecraft plugin that replaces abusive or toxic words (English + Hindi/Hinglish) with positive, funny, or wholesome alternatives, keeping your server chat clean, friendly, and fun for everyone!
body:
**PoliteChat** makes your Minecraft server chat positive and family-friendly by automatically filtering abusive or offensive words — including **English and Hindi/Hinglish slang** — and replacing them with kind or funny alternatives.
No more toxicity — just good vibes, clean chat and a happier community!

## 🌟 Features

- 🧹 **Smart Word Replacement** — Detects bad words and replaces them instantly.
- 🇮🇳  **English + Hindi/Hinglish Support** — Protects your chat in both languages.
- ⚙️ **Fully Configurable** — Add or edit word pairs directly from `config.yml`.
- 🔄 **Dynamic Commands** — Add or remove replacements while the server is running.
- 🎨 **Lightweight & Lag-Free** — Optimized for performance on all server sizes.

## ⚙️ Commands
| Command                                  | Description                              |
| ---------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `/politechat reload`                     | Reloads the plugin configuration.        |
| `/politechat add <badword> <politeword>` | Adds a new replacement word dynamically. |
| `/politechat remove <badword>`           | Removes an existing replacement.         |


## 🔐 Permissions
| Permission          | Description               |
| ------------------- | --------------------------|
| `politechat.admin`  | Allows use of the plugin. |


## ⚠️ Word Replacement Warning
Due to platform restrictions, the included example config only shows safe placeholder words.
You can safely add your own replacements (English or Hinglish) in the generated config.yml after first run.

## 🧩 Installation
1. Download the latest PoliteChat.jar file.
2. Place it inside your server’s `/plugins` folder.
3. Restart or reload your server.
4. Edit `config.yml` to customize words and settings.
